title: Willow Amphitheatre
description: A bright triple-time concertino places a dancing solo against a spare pizzicato-like bass. A third voice enters under the sustained melody, turning the centre into a small chamber ensemble. The opening returns with a fuller reply and a crisp, open-air conclusion.
technical_note: Keep the moving inner right-hand voice separate from the held top notes. Use finger substitution where comfortable and avoid pressing the upper sustain. The quick outer sections should be buoyant, with short bass releases and clear phrase lifts.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
